selection_rule: within each window, test ascending rational primes and select the first with good reduction, R-coordinate denominators invertible, prime #E(Fp), and nonidentity reduced Q; retain every tested prime and status; a window with none remains no_eligible_prime
selection_boundary: prime/order eligibility and window bounds only; never inspect R/G scalar, relation index, coverage or coordinate peak during selection
coefficient_cap: B=floor(sqrt(q))+2 for selected prime group order q; enumerate all nonzero (a,b) in [-B,B]^2
candidate_order: ascending Decimal quadratic height score hQQ*a^2+2*hQR*a*b+hRR*b^2, then a,b; point construction follows sorting
relation_event: first nonzero rational aQ+bR reducing to identity, or first two distinct rational candidates with equal nonidentity reduction; derive R/G scalar from coefficient difference and verify it
coverage: stop each selected prime on coverage of all q-1 nonidentity reduced points or at the full coefficient cap; retain capped and unselected windows
work: record all selection decisions, first relation and coverage indices, exact rational coordinate bit peaks, distinct reductions and status; share exact rational point cache only inside this structural panel and report its construction count
claim_boundary: preregistered finite panel on one rational curve; no timed single-target or random-curve generalization
